chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ismail al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Sharia (Law) of Noah (peace be upon him) was that Allah should be worshipped with Oneness (Tawhid), sincerity, and casting off of partners (al-andad), and this is the primordial nature (Fitrah) upon which Allah created mankind.
And Allah took a covenant from Noah (peace be upon him) and the Prophets (peace be upon them) that they would worship Allah, the Exalted, and not associate anything with Him.
And He commanded Salat, enjoining the good, forbidding the evil, and distinguishing between the permissible (Halal) and the forbidden (Haram).
And He did not prescribe upon him the rulings of fixed limits (Hudud), nor designate inheritances; so this was his Sharia.
So Noah remained among them for a thousand years except fifty years, calling them secretly and openly.
So when they refused and rebelled, he said to his Lord: 'I have been overcome, so grant me victory!'
So Allah, the Mighty and Exalted, revealed to him: 'No one from your people will believe except those who have already believed, so do not be grieved by what they used to do [do].'
For that reason Noah (peace be upon him) said: 'And they will not give birth except to a wicked, disbelieving one.'
So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to him: 'Make the ship.'
ai.seo_question: What was the specific Sharia and legal obligations of Prophet Noah (peace be upon him) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the continuity of the primordial Fitrah across prophetic eras, noting that Noah’s Sharia focused on core monotheism and moral exhortation rather than the detailed penal codes (Hudud) or inheritance laws introduced later. It underscores the divine patience and the specific revelation that salvation was limited to those already believing, a nuance that informs the theological understanding of pre-flood election before the command to construct the Ark.

en.hubeali: H 14872 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abaan Bin Usmaan, from Ismail Al-Ju’fy, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’farasws having said:

‘The Law (Sharia) of Noah<sup>as</sup> was that they should worship Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with Oneness (Al-Tauheed), and have sincerity, and not associate others,  ‘وَ هِيَ الْفِطْرَةُ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ’ and this is the natured upon which the people have been Created.

And Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Took a Covenant with Noah<sup>as</sup> and to All the Prophets<sup>as</sup> that they<sup>as</sup> would worship Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and will not associate anything with Him<sup>azwj</sup>,
and Commanded for the Salat, and the enjoining of the good, and the prohibiting of the bad, and the Permissibles, and the Prohibitions,
and did not Necessitate upon them the rules of the Limits, nor about the necessary inheritance.
So this is the Law which Noah<sup>as</sup> remained upon among them for a thousand years except for fifty years (950) calling them secretly and in the open.
So when they refused and rebelled, he<sup>as</sup> said to his<sup>as</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>: ‘I<sup>as</sup> have been overcome, so Help!’

So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto him<sup>as</sup>: “No one else from your<sup>as</sup> people are going to believe except for the ones who have already believed, so do not be disheartened at what they have done”.
So for that reason Noah<sup>as</sup> said: ‘They will not give birth to anyone except tyrannous infidels’.
So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto him<sup>as</sup> to make the ship’.
en.sarwar: 425. From him, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad together, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali, from Umar Bin Abaan, from Ismail Al-Ju’fy, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said that:

‘When Noah (as) planted the seeds, his (as) people passed by him. They laughed at him (as) and were mocking him (as) and were saying, ‘He (as) has become a planter (farmer)’, until the trees became tall and mighty, he (as) cut them, then carved them. So they said, ‘He (as) has become a carpenter’.
Then he (as) composed it into a ship.
